algorithm: Existing center-sampled nearest-neighbor rule. One-step resize from a hash-verified corresponding high-resolution backup when available, otherwise current source; no palette or alpha rewrite.
scope: Active ordinary item sprites only; buildings, machines, vehicles and their shared sprites, natural resources, characters, UI, atlases and reference samples excluded.

knownQuantizationLoss.description: Very thin shaft has local discontinuities at 64x21. Explicit uniform64 selection retained without drawing new pixels or falling back to higher resolution.

visualReview.foodNote: Read/Write retained; sampled food particle tint may change slightly.

runtimeValidation: Not run: Unity remains in PlayMode and concurrent changes are active. No forced import, tests or APK build.
apkReduction: Not measured; PNG source reduction does not equal APK reduction.

excluded.reason: World resource, building, machine, vehicle or shared world-body texture
